data.name: Narsimha
data.gender_notes: Narsimha is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: Man-lion; the fourth avatar of Vishnu
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit nara, 'man', + siṃha, 'lion' — 'man-lion'. Its root is Sanskrit nara + siṃha. Narasimha, the fourth avatar of Vishnu. Narsimha is a Sanskrit name meaning “Man-lion; the fourth avatar of Vishnu”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Narsimha expresses “Man-lion; the fourth avatar of Vishnu”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Narsimha total 38, reducing to 2. Number 2 is associated with cooperation, sensitivity and balance.
